chunks: He said: Abu Hafs, Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi, informed me, saying: Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Katib al-Iskafi narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ash'ari narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, saying: al-Husayn ibn Zayd narrated to me, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon them both), who said:

The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said: The believers are brothers; they fulfill the needs of one another. And because they fulfill each other's needs, God will fulfill their needs on the Day of Resurrection.
And may God bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, and his family, and grant them peace.

key_terms.إخوة: Brothers, brethren — denoting a deep spiritual kinship beyond blood ties
key_terms.القيامة: The Day of Resurrection, the Day of Judgment
key_terms.حوائج: Needs, necessities — encompasses material, emotional, and spiritual needs

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about believers helping each other?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches that believers form a brotherhood of mutual aid and service. This hadith, transmitted through two Imams (al-Baqir and al-Sadiq), establishes a direct link between helping fellow believers in this world and receiving divine assistance on the Day of Judgment. It was likely delivered to encourage the early Muslim community to strengthen their bonds of solidarity and mutual support.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 8. He said: Abu Hafs, Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi, reported from Muhammad ibn Hammam al-Katib al-Iskafi, who reported from Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Himyari, who reported from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ash’ari, who reported from Abdullah ibn Ibrahim, who reported from al-Husayn ibn Zaid, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father (as) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "The believers are all brothers; each one fulfilling the needs of the other. And because they help each other when in need, Allah will fulfill their needs on the Day of Judgement."
And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, and his progeny, and send salutations.
